<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 235.1395, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 234.132 Da. A formula that matches this mass and the observed 13C isotopic pattern (≈ 16 % M+1, consistent with ~14 carbons) is C₁₄H₁₈O₃. This formula yields a calculated monoisotopic mass of 234.1256 Da, within the experimental error, and predicts the correct isotopic intensity. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C14H18O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
